sec3.sec3: A better life, one smart moment at a time
sec3.sec32: It works with ORVIBO smart lighting, audio and video systems and more, so you can create your own scenes.
scene.morning: Sunlight and music for a gentle wake-up
scene.morning_txt:
In the morning,
the curtains slowly open on schedule,
soft music starts to play,
and a beautiful day begins.
scene.night: Good night: sleep like in a five-star hotel
scene.night_txt:
When you grow sleepy,
one touch turns off the lights at home,
the curtains close softly, the air conditioner adjusts,
and your bedroom is ready for sleep.
scene.cinema: Time to unwind: a home cinema with one touch
scene.cinema_txt:
One touch turns on the TV,
dims the lights
and closes the curtains to shut out stray light,
for a cozy cinema feel.
container.container: Many ways to control it, a fresh touch to every day
container.title: Voice control: it opens and closes on command
container.txt:
Control it with the ORVIBO Home app or a voice assistant:
say the word, and the curtains open or close.
container.txt2: Works with voice control through Tmall Genie, the Xiaobai robot, Rokid and more.
container.title2: Phone or remote: one touch is enough
container.txt3: Besides voice control, you can open or close the curtains from afar with one touch in the phone app or on the remote (up to 30 m away).
container.txt4: Give the curtain a gentle pull: the smart motor senses it and starts on its own.
container.title4: Smart sensing: it stops when blocked
container.txt5: If the curtain meets strong resistance while it opens or closes, the motor stops, which protects it and extends its life.
container.container2: It remembers the window, and stops wherever you like
container.container3: It learns the width of the window by itself, so there are no travel limits to set by hand and setup takes less time. Precise, flexible limits let it stop half open, fully open, a quarter open and more.
sec9.sec9: Magnesium-aluminum alloy, made in one piece
sec9.sec92: The magnesium-aluminum body is anodized and sandblasted in five steps, for a rich metal finish that stays like new for years.
sec10.sec10: An aluminum alloy track that carries up to 50 kg
sec10.sec102: The aluminum-magnesium alloy track is up to 2.2 mm thick and carries up to 50 kg: solid quality that gives you more options.
fix.fix: A high-torque imported motor pulls heavy curtains with ease
fix.fix2: Its motor, imported from Germany, has strong torque and easily pulls all kinds of heavy curtains.
container.container4: Ultra-quiet planetary gears for calm and comfort
container.container5: Planetary gears with high mechanical strength and wear resistance keep the motor running quietly and steadily for years. At under 35 dB, far below the industry standard, it is as quiet as a whisper.
sec_add4.sec_add4: A new Zigbee solution: 100 m of coverage, stronger and steadier
sec_add4.sec_add42: Built for large spaces such as villas and hotels, the new Zigbee solution reaches up to 100 m, so smart scenes run faster and more reliably.
